content: He said he ___ tired.
explanation: 主句为过去时，间接引语从句时态相应后退。
zh: 他说他累了。

content: She said she ___ the film the day before.
explanation: 引语中「昨天」转为 the day before，时态用过去完成时。
zh: 她说她前一天看过那部电影。

content: He told me he ___ come the next day.
explanation: will 在间接引语中变为 would。
zh: 他告诉我他第二天会来。

content: She asked me ___ I was busy.
explanation: 一般疑问句转间接引语用 if 或 whether。
zh: 她问我是否忙。

content: He asked me where I ___ .
explanation: 间接引语中从句时态后退，且用陈述语序。
zh: 他问我住在哪里。

content: She said she ___ finished the report.
explanation: 现在完成时在间接引语中变为过去完成时。
zh: 她说她已经完成了报告。

content: He told us he ___ been waiting for an hour.
explanation: 现在完成进行时在间接引语中变为过去完成进行时。
zh: 他告诉我们他已经等了一个小时。

content: She said she ___ to the party that night.
explanation: 现在进行时在间接引语中变为过去进行时。
zh: 她说她那天晚上要去参加聚会。

content: He asked what time the train ___ .
explanation: 间接引语中从句时态随主句后退。
zh: 他问火车几点开。

content: She told me she ___ the keys on the table.
explanation: 一般现在时在间接引语中变为一般过去时。
zh: 她告诉我她把钥匙放在桌上了。

content: He said he ___ help me later.
explanation: will 变为 would。
zh: 他说他稍后会帮我。

content: She said she ___ swim when she was five.
explanation: can 在间接引语中变为 could。
zh: 她说她五岁时就会游泳。

content: He asked me ___ I had seen his wallet.
explanation: 一般疑问句用 if 引导。
zh: 他问我有没有看到他的钱包。

content: She said she ___ rather stay at home.
explanation: would rather 在间接引语中不变。
zh: 她说她宁愿待在家里。

content: He told me he ___ never been abroad.
explanation: 现在完成时变为过去完成时。
zh: 他告诉我他从没出过国。

content: She said, "I am busy." → She said she ___ busy.
explanation: am 在间接引语中变为 was。
zh: 她说她很忙。

content: He asked me ___ I could help him.
explanation: 请求转述用 ask + if。
zh: 他问我能否帮他。

content: She told him ___ quiet.
explanation: 祈使句转述用 tell sb to do sth。
zh: 她让他安静。

content: He asked me ___ leave the door open.
explanation: 否定祈使句转述用 ask sb not to do。
zh: 他让我别把门开着。

content: She said she ___ seen him the previous week.
explanation: 「上周」转述为 the previous week，时态用过去完成时。
zh: 她说她前一周见过他。

content: He said he would have finished if he ___ more time.
explanation: 第三条件句在间接引语中，从句用过去完成时。
zh: 他说如果时间更多他就完成了。

content: She asked whether we ___ the documents.
explanation: 间接引语中从句时态后退为过去完成时。
zh: 她问我们是否收到了文件。

content: He admitted he ___ the money.
explanation: 表示更早发生的动作，用过去完成时。
zh: 他承认拿了那笔钱。

content: She promised she ___ on time.
explanation: promise 后接 would 表示过去的将来。
zh: 她保证会准时。

content: He warned us ___ too close to the edge.
explanation: warn sb not to do sth 是固定结构。
zh: 他警告我们别靠边缘太近。

content: She suggested that we ___ the meeting.
explanation: suggest that 后接虚拟语气，用动词原形。
zh: 她建议我们推迟会议。

content: He insisted that she ___ present.
explanation: insist that 后接虚拟语气 be。
zh: 他坚持要她到场。

content: They claimed they ___ the work themselves.
explanation: claim 后接过去完成时，表示先于主句动作。
zh: 他们声称是他们自己完成了这项工作。

content: He denied that he ___ involved.
explanation: deny that 后从句时态后退。
zh: 他否认自己曾参与其中。

content: She explained that the delay ___ unavoidable.
explanation: 间接引语中时态后退。
zh: 她解释说延误是不可避免的。

content: He told me he ___ the report by then.
explanation: by then 表示过去的将来某时之前，用 would have done。
zh: 他告诉我到那时他已经完成报告了。

content: She asked me how long I ___ there.
explanation: 过去完成进行时表示持续到过去某时点的动作。
zh: 她问我在那儿工作多久了。

content: He advised me ___ the offer.
explanation: advise sb to do sth 是固定结构。
zh: 他建议我接受这个提议。

content: They announced that the results ___ later.
explanation: 过去的将来被动语态用 would be + 过去分词。
zh: 他们宣布结果将在稍后公布。

content: He complained that he ___ enough time.
explanation: 间接引语中时态后退为过去式。
zh: 他抱怨说他没有足够时间。

content: She told me she ___ the letter that morning.
explanation: 「今天早上」转述为 that morning，时态用过去完成时。
zh: 她告诉我她那天早上把信寄出了。

content: He asked me ___ I had any experience.
explanation: 一般疑问句转述用 whether 或 if。
zh: 他问我是否有经验。

content: She said she ___ rather not discuss it.
explanation: would rather 保持不变。
zh: 她说她宁愿不讨论这件事。

content: He offered ___ me to the airport.
explanation: offer to do sth 是固定结构。
zh: 他主动提出开车送我去机场。

content: They refused ___ the terms.
explanation: refuse to do sth 是固定结构。
zh: 他们拒绝接受这些条件。

content: She is a very ___ girl.
explanation: 修饰名词用形容词 beautiful。
zh: 她是个很漂亮的女孩。

content: This is an ___ book.
explanation: 修饰物用 -ing 形式的形容词。
zh: 这是本有趣的书。

content: I was ___ to hear the news.
explanation: 人作主语描述感受用 -ed 形式。
zh: 听到这个消息我很惊讶。

content: The weather is very ___ today.
explanation: 作表语用形容词 cold。
zh: 今天天气很冷。

content: He is ___ than his brother.
explanation: than 前用比较级。
zh: 他比他哥哥高。

content: This is the ___ building in the city.
explanation: the + 最高级表示在范围内最……。
zh: 这是城里最高的建筑。

content: The film was ___ than I expected.
explanation: good 的比较级是 better。
zh: 这部电影比我预期的好。

content: This is the ___ mistake I have ever made.
explanation: bad 的最高级是 worst。
zh: 这是我犯过最严重的错误。

content: She is as ___ as her sister.
explanation: as... as 之间用原级。
zh: 她和她姐姐一样高。

content: This exercise is ___ than the last one.
explanation: easy 的比较级是 easier。
zh: 这个练习比上一个容易。

content: The room is not big ___ for six people.
explanation: enough 放在形容词之后。
zh: 这个房间不够六个人住。

content: The soup is too ___ to drink.
explanation: too + 形容词 + to do 结构。
zh: 这汤太烫了，喝不了。

content: He is ___ to reach the top shelf.
explanation: enough 修饰形容词时后置。
zh: 他够高，能够到最上面那层架子。

content: This is a ___ problem.
explanation: 修饰名词用形容词。
zh: 这是个严重的问题。

content: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
explanation: 修饰物（the film）用 -ing 形式。
zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我睡着了。

content: The two options are equally ___ .
explanation: 作表语用形容词 attractive。
zh: 这两个选项同样有吸引力。

content: He was ___ of the risk involved.
explanation: be unaware of 意为「未意识到」。
zh: 他没有意识到其中的风险。

content: Timing is ___ in this negotiation.
explanation: 作表语用形容词 crucial，意为「至关重要的」。
zh: 在这场谈判中时机至关重要。

content: The results were ___ with our expectations.
explanation: be consistent with 意为「与……一致」。
zh: 结果与我们的预期一致。

content: This is a ___ opportunity we cannot miss.
explanation: 修饰名词用形容词 rare。
zh: 这是个不能错过的难得机会。

content: The more you read, the ___ your vocabulary becomes.
explanation: the more... the + 比较级 结构。
zh: 读得越多，词汇量越丰富。

content: He is ___ of his achievements.
explanation: be proud of 意为「为……自豪」。
zh: 他为自己的成就感到自豪。

content: She is ___ at dealing with complaints.
explanation: be good at 意为「擅长」。
zh: 她擅长处理投诉。

content: The weather was ___ than we had hoped.
explanation: bad 的比较级是 worse。
zh: 天气比我们期望的差。

content: This is the ___ solution available.
explanation: the + 最高级，simple 的最高级是 simplest。
zh: 这是目前可用的最简单的方案。

content: He is ___ to criticism.
explanation: be sensitive to 意为「对……敏感」。
zh: 他对批评很敏感。

content: The proposal is ___ to the one we rejected.
explanation: be similar to 意为「与……相似」。
zh: 这个提案与我们否决过的那个相似。

content: The findings are ___ with previous research.
explanation: be consistent with 意为「与……一致」。
zh: 这些发现与先前研究一致。

content: He was ___ to admit his mistake.
explanation: be reluctant to do 意为「不情愿做」。
zh: 他不愿承认自己的错误。

content: The evidence is ___ from conclusive.
explanation: far from conclusive 意为「远非定论」。
zh: 这些证据远非定论。

content: The two theories are mutually ___ .
explanation: mutually exclusive 意为「互相排斥的」。
zh: 这两种理论互相排斥。

content: The results are ___ to interpretation.
explanation: be open to interpretation 意为「可以有多种解读」。
zh: 这些结果可以有多种解读。

content: She was ___ about the outcome.
explanation: be optimistic about 意为「对……乐观」。
zh: 她对结果很乐观。

content: The problem is far more ___ than it appears.
explanation: more + 形容词原级构成比较级。
zh: 这个问题远比表面看起来复杂。

content: He is ___ of taking risks.
explanation: be capable of doing 意为「有能力做」。
zh: 他有能力承担风险。

content: The data is ___ to error.
explanation: be prone to 意为「易于……的」。
zh: 这些数据容易出现误差。

content: The claim is ___ of scrutiny.
explanation: be worthy of 意为「值得」。
zh: 这一说法经得起推敲。

content: The outcome was ___ from what we predicted.
explanation: be different from 意为「与……不同」。
zh: 结果与我们的预测不同。

content: He was ___ for the position.
explanation: ineligible for 意为「没有资格……的」。
zh: 他没有资格担任这个职位。

content: The report is ___ of serious errors.
explanation: be free of 意为「没有、不含」。
zh: 这份报告没有严重错误。

content: The ___ are playing outside.
explanation: child 的复数是不规则形式 children。
zh: 孩子们在外面玩。

content: There are three ___ in the room.
explanation: woman 的复数是 women。
zh: 房间里有三个女人。

content: I need some ___ .
explanation: bread 是不可数名词。
zh: 我需要一些面包。

content: She gave me two ___ of advice.
explanation: 不可数名词用量词计量：two pieces of advice。
zh: 她给了我两条建议。

content: My ___ are in the drawer.
explanation: key 的复数直接加 -s。
zh: 我的钥匙在抽屉里。

content: They bought a lot of new ___ last month.
explanation: furniture 是不可数名词。
zh: 他们上个月买了很多新家具。

content: He gave me some useful ___ .
explanation: advice 不可数，没有复数形式。
zh: 他给了我一些有用的建议。

content: Could you give me some ___ ?
explanation: information 是不可数名词。
zh: 你能给我一些信息吗？

content: The ___ is nice today.
explanation: weather 是不可数名词。
zh: 今天天气不错。

content: She has made great ___ .
explanation: progress 不可数，make progress 意为「取得进步」。
zh: 她取得了很大进步。

content: There are two ___ of milk in the fridge.
explanation: 不可数名词用容器量词计量。
zh: 冰箱里有两瓶牛奶。

content: My ___ hurts.
explanation: tooth 的复数是 teeth；此处作主语指多颗牙。
zh: 我的牙疼。

content: The ___ are playing in the garden.
explanation: children 本身已是复数形式。
zh: 孩子们在花园里玩。

content: I bought two ___ of shoes.
explanation: a pair of shoes 的复数是 pairs of shoes。
zh: 我买了两双鞋。

content: There is some ___ on the floor.
explanation: paper 作「纸」解时不可数。
zh: 地上有一些纸。

content: The ___ of the two plans is unclear.
explanation: 冠词 the 后需要名词 difference。
zh: 这两个计划的区别不清楚。

content: His ___ to the proposal was unexpected.
explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词 objection。
zh: 他对这个提案的反对出人意料。

content: The company reported a sharp ___ in profits.
explanation: a sharp + 名词，用 decline。
zh: 公司报告利润大幅下降。

content: There has been a marked ___ in crime.
explanation: a marked + 名词，用 reduction。
zh: 犯罪率明显下降。

content: Her ___ of the situation was accurate.
explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词。
zh: 她对形势的判断是准确的。

content: The ___ of the results surprised everyone.
explanation: 冠词 the 后需要名词 accuracy。
zh: 结果的准确性让所有人惊讶。

content: We need to reach an ___ on the price.
explanation: an + 名词 agreement。
zh: 我们需要在价格上达成一致。

content: The ___ of the two theories is striking.
explanation: the + 名词 similarity。
zh: 这两种理论的相似之处很显著。

content: His ___ for the job was rejected.
explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词 application。
zh: 他这份工作的申请被拒了。

content: The ___ of the evidence was questioned.
explanation: the + 名词 reliability。
zh: 证据的可靠性受到质疑。

content: The ___ of the findings is disputed.
explanation: the + 名词 interpretation。
zh: 这些发现的解读存在争议。

content: There is little ___ of a recovery.
explanation: little 修饰不可数名词 prospect，表示「可能性」。
zh: 复苏的可能性很小。

content: The ___ of the policy remains unclear.
explanation: the + 名词 implementation。
zh: 该政策的落实仍不清楚。

content: He has considerable ___ in the field.
explanation: 不可数名词 expertise 意为「专业知识」。
zh: 他在这一领域有相当的专业知识。

content: The ___ between the two is significant.
explanation: the + 名词 distinction。
zh: 两者的区别很显著。

content: The ___ of the project is uncertain.
explanation: the + 名词 viability。
zh: 这个项目的可行性不确定。

content: There has been a ___ in demand.
explanation: a + 名词 shift。
zh: 需求出现了转变。

content: The ___ of the data took weeks.
explanation: the + 名词 analysis。
zh: 数据分析花了好几周。

content: His ___ of the argument was persuasive.
explanation: 形容词性物主代词后接名词 refutation。
zh: 他对该论点的反驳很有说服力。

content: The ___ of resources is a major constraint.
explanation: the + 名词 scarcity。
zh: 资源稀缺是一个主要制约。

content: There is growing ___ about the policy.
explanation: 不可数名词 concern 表示「担忧」。
zh: 人们对这项政策的担忧日益增长。

content: The ___ of the scheme was questioned.
explanation: the + 名词 feasibility。
zh: 该方案的可行性受到质疑。

content: His ___ for detail is remarkable.
explanation: an eye for detail 意为「对细节的敏锐」。
zh: 他对细节的敏锐令人称奇。

content: The ___ of the report is confidential.
explanation: the content of 意为「……的内容」。
zh: 这份报告的内容是保密的。

content: There is no ___ that he is qualified.
explanation: no doubt that 意为「毫无疑问」。
zh: 毫无疑问他是合格的。

content: She did the job ___ .
explanation: 修饰动词 did 用副词 well。
zh: 这份工作她做得好。

content: She drives very ___ .
explanation: 修饰动词用副词 carefully。
zh: 她开车很小心。

content: They arrived ___ .
explanation: late 意为「晚」；lately 意为「最近」。
zh: 他们来晚了。

content: I haven't seen him ___ .
explanation: lately 意为「最近」，常与现在完成时连用。
zh: 我最近没见过他。

content: She works ___ than anyone else.
explanation: hard 的比较级是 harder，意为「更努力」。
zh: 她比任何人都努力。

content: I can ___ hear you.
explanation: hardly 意为「几乎不」。
zh: 我几乎听不见你说话。

content: He finished the test ___ .
explanation: 修饰动词用副词 quickly。
zh: 他很快就做完了测试。

content: She sings ___ .
explanation: 修饰动词用副词 beautifully。
zh: 她唱得很美。

content: The report was ___ researched.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 researched 用副词。
zh: 这份报告研究得很透彻。

content: ___ , the plan did not work.
explanation: 句首修饰整句用副词 Unfortunately。
zh: 遗憾的是，计划没有奏效。

content: He was ___ injured in the accident.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 injured 用副词。
zh: 他在事故中受了重伤。

content: She is ___ aware of the risk.
explanation: 修饰形容词 aware 用副词 fully。
zh: 她完全清楚风险。

content: The results were ___ unexpected.
explanation: 修饰形容词用副词。
zh: 结果完全出乎意料。

content: He ___ admitted his mistake.
explanation: 修饰动词用副词 eventually。
zh: 他最终承认了自己的错误。

content: She handled the situation ___ .
explanation: 修饰动词用副词。
zh: 她很专业地处理了这个局面。

content: The train was ___ delayed.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 delayed 用副词。
zh: 火车轻微晚点。

content: He is ___ the best candidate.
explanation: arguably 意为「可以说」，修饰整个判断。
zh: 可以说他是最合适的人选。

content: She was ___ late for the meeting.
explanation: 此处应为 usual（as usual 结构）之外的常见搭配；usually 表示「通常」。
zh: 她开会通常都会迟到。

content: The two approaches differ ___ .
explanation: 修饰动词 differ 用副词。
zh: 这两种方法有本质区别。

content: He responded ___ to the criticism.
explanation: 修饰动词用副词。
zh: 他对批评的回应带着防御性。

content: The scheme was ___ funded.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 funded 用副词。
zh: 该方案得到了充足的资金支持。

content: She spoke ___ about her plans.
explanation: 修饰动词 spoke 用副词。
zh: 她坦率地谈了自己的计划。

content: The evidence was ___ weak.
explanation: notoriously 意为「出了名地」，修饰形容词。
zh: 这些证据出了名地薄弱。

content: The results were ___ consistent.
explanation: 修饰形容词 consistent 用副词。
zh: 结果异常一致。

content: He was ___ criticised for the decision.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 criticised 用副词 widely。
zh: 他因这个决定受到广泛批评。

content: The claim is ___ unfounded.
explanation: 修饰形容词 unfounded 用副词。
zh: 这一说法完全没有根据。

content: She is ___ regarded as an expert.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 regarded 用副词。
zh: 她普遍被认为是专家。

content: The findings were ___ reported.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 reported 用副词。
zh: 这些发现被准确地报道了。

content: He ___ underestimated the difficulty.
explanation: grossly 意为「严重地、极度地」，修饰动词。
zh: 他严重低估了难度。

content: The two are ___ related.
explanation: closely related 意为「密切相关」。
zh: 两者密切相关。

content: The policy was ___ implemented.
explanation: 修饰过去分词 implemented 用副词。
zh: 该政策执行得很差。

content: She was ___ surprised by the news.
explanation: utterly 意为「完全地」，修饰形容词。
zh: 这个消息让她完全惊呆了。

content: The argument is ___ sound.
explanation: theoretically sound 意为「理论上站得住脚」。
zh: 这个论证在理论上站得住脚。

content: He was ___ responsible for the failure.
explanation: largely 意为「在很大程度上」。
zh: 他对这次失败负有很大责任。

content: The scheme was ___ successful.
explanation: partially 意为「部分地」，修饰形容词。
zh: 该方案部分成功。
